text:
```yaml
name: Update Requests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  update-requests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
      with:
        php-version: '8.1'
        extensions: mbstring, intl, gd, exif, iconv, xml, zip, bcmath, dom, curl, json, pcntl, readline, session, soap, spl, standard, tokenizer, xsl, zend-opcache

    - name: Install Composer
      uses: actions/setup-composer@v2

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader

    - name: Run Behat tests
      run: vendor/bin/behat

    - name: Debugging
      run: echo "Debugging information"
      shell: bash

    - name: Strip ANSI codes for pagers without color support
      run: |
        #!/bin/bash
        # Check if the PAGER environment variable is set
        if [ -z "$PAGER" ]; then
          PAGER="less -R"
        fi

        # Check if the pager supports colors
        if ! $PAGER --version | grep -q "color"; then
          # Strip ANSI codes using sed
          sed 's/\x1b\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]//g' < input.txt > output.txt
        else
          # Pass the output directly to the pager
          $PAGER < input.txt
        fi
      env:
        PAGER: "less -R"

    - name: Log output
      run: cat output.txt
```
